issues.description: The UML and problem statement declare RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as an int and require public getters for all attributes. In the solution, the getter getNumberOfLoopings() returns double (casting the int to double) rather than returning int. This mismatches the attribute type and the explicit instruction to provide getters matching attributes, and will confuse students (they will expect an int-returning getter) and can cause failing tests or misinterpretation of the attribute type.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the getter return the same type as the attribute. Change the getter signature and implementation to: public int getNumberOfLoopings() { return numberOfLoopings; } (or, if the intent was to have a double attribute, change the attribute to double consistently in UML, template, and solution).
